basis: Cataracts and aberrant oral frenula define the syndrome; cavernous vascular hemangiomas occur in 30-79%. Short stature alone does not establish skeletal damage.
Progressive retinal dystrophy, iris coloboma and congenital cataracts are ocular abnormalities.
CASK-related intellectual disability with epilepsy and developmental impairment; nystagmus does not establish separate ocular damage.
Severe congenital sensorineural hearing loss; associated sperm abnormalities and infertility are reproductive, without an additional axis.
The definition specifies nonsyndromic PITX3-related cataract; unquantified neurologic annotations do not establish common involvement.
A lymphoid-cell malignancy arising within the brain or spinal cord; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
Primary ovarian insufficiency is failure of gonadal endocrine function; menstrual abnormalities and infertility add no separate axis.
Alveolar calcium-phosphate accumulation damages lung tissue. Right ventricular failure occurs in 5-29%; systemic calcifications are rare.
Acanthamoeba infection umbrella; ocular and CNS damage depend on the keratitis or encephalitis subtype.
Renal arterial disease produces secondary hypertension; arteries are cardiovascular, and renal parenchymal damage is not required.
Tumor originates in the colon; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease or hormone dysfunction.
Bacterial infection umbrella spanning many anatomical sites; no specific organ is consistently affected across the group.
Malignant tumor originates in a peripheral nerve sheath; mediastinal location does not establish lung involvement.
GPI-anchor biosynthesis disorder with encephalopathy; contractures 7/7, hepatic steatosis/failure 1/1. Cardiac findings omitted under cap; hepatic frequency evidence is sparse.
GUCA1B-related rod-cone retinal degeneration causes visual impairment.
The defining phenotype combines cleft palate, congenital heart disease, polydactyly and absent tibia; no additional manifestations are supplied.
VIP-secreting endocrine pancreatic tumor; defining WDHA syndrome includes persistent intestinal secretory dysfunction, hypokalemia and reduced gastric acid secretion.
Disease of the cardiac mitral valve; rheumatic disease is only one subtype.
Neurogenic tumor originates in neural tissue of the eyelid; eyelids belong to the ocular axis.
Filarial infection of skin/subcutis and eyes, defined by onchodermatitis, subcutaneous nodules and ocular inflammatory disease.
Isolated sperm structural and motility defects cause male infertility; no endocrine dysfunction or other axis involvement is established.
Sterol biosynthesis disorder with skeletal dysplasia and ichthyosis; cataracts occur in 6/8. Tracheal cartilage anomalies omitted under the four-axis cap.
Benign tumor occupies the buccal oral mucosa, which belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Adult dendritic-cell neoplasm with pulmonary disease emphasized by its parents; destructive bone lesions affect roughly half. Skin and pituitary frequencies vary.
Microbial infection directly inflames the peritoneum; secondary multiorgan dysfunction does not establish common direct involvement of other axes.
